sasha: Quick check — ran onboarding benches for 70B across H100 vs A100 in us-west and eu-west. Need sizing recs for Dedicated (GPU count + autoscale cushion). p95 SLO = 400ms. TL;DR numbers below.

sasha: ```
us-west  | H100 | q4f16 | p50 58ms | p95 310ms | tok/s 290 | eff conv/gpu ~10
us-west  | A100 | q4f16 | p50 83ms | p95 470ms | tok/s 215 | eff conv/gpu ~6
eu-west  | H100 | q4f16 | p50 65ms | p95 335ms | tok/s 270
eu-west  | A100 | q4f16 | p50 90ms | p95 525ms | tok/s 200

us-west  | H100 | int8  | p95 280ms | tok/s 330 (but +2.4% eval delta)
```

maria: Nice. can you paste the bench command and warmup details + seq len / batch?

sasha: ```bash
bench-run --model 70b --device=h100 --seq 1024 --batch 1 --tokens 512 --warmup 300 --concurrency-scan 1-16
# note: export RUN_KERNEL=trigem_fast for seq>1024 on H100
```

devon: From numbers: H100 in us-west meets p95 but A100 struggles in both regions. For Dedicated sizing I'd start with: per-region concurrency cap = 10 on H100, 6 on A100. Set autoscale "elastic buffer" = 40% (runway for bursts). Keeps p95 under 400ms with safety.

quant-qa: INT8 gives throughput win (tok/s + ~15%) but evals show quality drop (dialog_flow_v2 eval: -2.3% aggregate). If product requires parity, keep q4f16 as default and use INT8 only as opt-in or fallback for cost-sensitive lanes.

remy: Also note kernel choice: trigem_fast-attn on H100 shaved ~15% off p95 for seq>1024 in our microbench. Recommend enabling kernel selection policy for H100 pools.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: created runbook '70b-dedicated-sizing' with params -> min_gpus=2, target_concurrency={"H100": "10", "A100": "6"}, autoscale_cushion=40%, canary=10% for 24h.

maria: Quick capacity calc check — if steady-state qps (region) ~= 1,200 tok/s and H100 tok/s per GPU ~290, raw GPUs = 1200/290 ~= 4.1 -> round up 5, plus 40% cushion -> 7 GPUs. devon: agree => provision 8 to be safe.

devon: Also recommend floor capacity >=2 GPUs to avoid cold-start noise and set scale-step small (1 GPU) for smooth autoscale. Canary 10% traffic to H100 pool for first 24h.

sasha: Thanks all. I'll open the PR to pin the rollout + fallback rule: fallback INT8->q4f16 when eval delta > 1%. attaching charts to the runbook: https://redwood-internal/dash/70b-onboard (dash link). @devon @maria :thumbsup:

maria: sounds good. i'll sync with capacity planning for reserved commits tomorrow.

sasha: Will follow up with the perf traces and the small p95 histogram for each kernel.
